metadata.name: Syndicated Synthetic Master Catalogue
metadata.master_is_source_of_truth_for: Synthetic MVP comparisons after catalogue creation
metadata.concatenation: Append all 850/861/810 lines; concatenate buyer_id|supplier_id|UPC or exact buyer_sku+vendor_sku to deduplicate product identity.
metadata.numeric_transport: Integers are JSON numbers; non-integer decimal values are strings to preserve exact precision.
metadata.pack_inference_scope: Synthetic inference requires agreeing EA/CS quantity and price ratios within the same PO/line/currency. It is not real-world verification.
metadata.no_pack_evidence: Keep pack_size null; an EA-only product does not establish eaches per case.
metadata.currency_policy: Never compare or blend prices from different currencies.
metadata.missing_value_policy: Select only supplied or explicitly inferred candidates; absent evidence remains null.
metadata.source_identity_policy: Conflicting SKU pairs remain separate; descriptions and line numbers do not merge different products.
metadata.quantity_scope: Synthetic reference quantities are PO-line specific, not product attributes or verified receipt counts.
metadata.deduplication: Exact document payload and exact repeated line within a document; distinct invoices/events remain observations.
